primary_meaning: The essential nature of God and the ultimate Christian virtue, characterized by unconditional, selfless, and sacrificial devotion to the well-being of others.

alternatives.meaning: Covenant loyalty, lovingkindness, and steadfast mercy (Hebrew hesed)
Brotherly affection and mutual friendship (Greek phileo)
The summation and complete fulfillment of the divine law

notes: While love is primarily a literal theological reality rather than a strict symbol, Christian interpretation universally elevates it as the supreme paradigm of the faith. Interpretation heavily relies on linguistic distinctions, especially contrasting the Greek agape (divine, unconditional, sacrificial love) with phileo (brotherly affection) and eros (romantic love), as well as emphasizing the Old Testament Hebrew concept of hesed (covenantal faithfulness).
